summary: Diginex Limited, a London-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an Extraordinary General Meeting scheduled for 20 November 2026, with proxy materials mailed on or about 12 November 2026. Shareholders will vote on three proposals: increasing authorized share capital to US$520,000 divided into 1,295,000,000 ordinary shares and 5,000,000 preferred shares via creation of 800,000,000 new ordinary shares; a conforming memorandum amendment; and a new share consolidation contingent on a previously approved Transaction not closing first. No price, stake, premium or advisor is stated; this is routine meeting/capital-structure administration.
